data_boundary_handling: This is the one stage in the sequence where an external worker legitimately needs the verification environment, because reproducing a stochastic ladder claim cannot be done without it. Handled by local provisioning, not by transmission: .env and apps/server/.env were copied into the verifier's isolated worktree by the coordinator, and three disposable databases were created in advance. The packet itself carries no secret value - it names environment variables and database names only - so no excluded payload class enters it. The packet additionally instructs the verifier never to echo, print, or quote any env file content or connection string, and to redact credentials in any output it reproduces, because failing output is where values leak.
